# Ronning Systems, LLC

> Ronning Systems, LLC is the Portland, Oregon metro practice of Patrick Ronning — an interim and fractional technology executive for healthcare and regulated organizations. Most recently Director of Technology Services / CIO of Oregon State Hospital (32-FTE, $15M technology organization): network availability 95% to 99.5% in one quarter, ~25% operating savings in six months, three enterprise risks closed, and a governed LLM policy chatbot on Microsoft Azure. 15+ years shipping mission-critical systems — FDA Software as a Medical Device (Manna Health, BrightInsight), avionics (Garmin), launch vehicles (Virgin Orbit).

Ronning Systems provides interim and fractional CTO/CIO services, project execution in regulated environments, and board & technical advisory. Products built by Ronning Systems include Joblign (a job application platform) and One Step, a next-generation digital health offering in development.
